read_only_queries.matching_email:
with matches as (
 select c.uuid,c.raw_response,
 encode(sha256(convert_to(replace(jsonb_build_array(c.raw_response->>'source',c.raw_response->>'source_id',c.raw_response->>'event_type',c.raw_response->>'event_id',c.raw_response->>'revision')::text,', ',','),'UTF8')),'hex') h
 from public.agent_input_cache c
 where c.raw_response->>'source'='gmail' and exists (
 select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(c.raw_response#>'{payload,payload,headers}','[]'::jsonb)) header
 where lower(header->>'name')='subject' and lower(trim(header->>'value'))='test'
 ))
 select count(*)::int matching_messages,
 count(*) filter(where raw_response->>'event_type'='email_received')::int full_messages,
 bool_and(raw_response->>'source_id'='2fa17434-212d-408d-ab20-448f8c2c5907') correct_source,
 array_agg(distinct raw_response->>'event_type') event_types,
 min((raw_response->>'received_at')::timestamptz) first_received_at,
 max((raw_response->>'received_at')::timestamptz) last_received_at,
 bool_and(jsonb_typeof(raw_response->'payload')='object' and jsonb_typeof(raw_response#>'{payload,payload}')='object' and jsonb_typeof(raw_response#>'{payload,payload,headers}')='array') full_provider_structure,
 bool_and((raw_response#>>'{payload,id}')=raw_response->>'event_id' and (raw_response->>'event_id') ~ '^[a-fA-F0-9]{1,64}$' and length(raw_response->>'revision')>0) provider_identity_consistent,
 bool_and(uuid::text=substring(h,1,8)||'-'||substring(h,9,4)||'-5'||substring(h,14,3)||'-'||substring('89ab',(strpos('0123456789abcdef',substring(h,17,1))-1)%4+1,1)||substring(h,18,3)||'-'||substring(h,21,12)) stable_uuid_matches_event_identity,
 bool_and(exists(select 1 from public.agent_automation_state s where s.key='input:'||matches.uuid::text and s.data->>'status'='pending' and s.data->>'source'='gmail' and s.data->>'source_id'=matches.raw_response->>'source_id' and s.data->>'event_id'=matches.raw_response->>'event_id' and s.data->>'revision'=matches.raw_response->>'revision' and not(s.data ? 'payload'))) pending_metadata_matches
 from matches
read_only_queries.checkpoint: select data->>'status' status,data->>'lastSyncAt' last_sync_at,data ? 'lease' has_lease from public.agent_automation_state where key='subscription:gmail:2fa17434-212d-408d-ab20-448f8c2c5907'
